title: NeuronAI v2.0: biophysical EEG digital twins with simulation-based inference for in silico pharmacology
description: Reproducible code, trained models, simulation banks and derived results accompanying the article 'NeuronAI: biophysical EEG digital twins and simulation-based inference for personalised in silico neuropharmacology in autism'. Includes a 17-column extended Wendling neural mass model with AMPA/NMDA-GluN2A/GluN2B transmission and dopaminergic, serotonergic and noradrenergic gain control, amortised simulation-based inference with conformal uncertainty, a forward emulator, a sparse in silico pharmacological search, validation scripts, a test suite and a Google Colab version.
